name: Ronnie Foster
hook: A jazz organist whose Blue Note debut gave A Tribe Called Quest the keyboard loop of 'Electric Relaxation'.
blurb: Ronnie Foster is an organist from Buffalo, New York. His first album, Two Headed Freap, came out on the jazz label Blue Note in 1972. One track, 'Mystic Brew', has a soft, melancholy keyboard phrase. In 1993 A Tribe Called Quest looped it for 'Electric Relaxation', and it has been sampled and covered many times since. Foster is on the map as a much-sampled source (Q21), and 'Mystic Brew' is a clear case of a jazz label's catalogue becoming a hip-hop producer's library: Blue Note's 1970s records were among the most mined sources of the 1990s.

signatureTracks.title: Alone Again (Naturally)
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: His version of Gilbert O'Sullivan's song, from his second album, Sweet Revival. It is the same song whose sampling by Biz Markie ended in court.
